name: Review Backend Changes
description: Reviews Java backend files for Spring Boot best practices when created or edited

then.prompt: Review the new Java file against our backend standards: (1) Controllers handle HTTP concerns only — no business logic. (2) Services contain business logic, use constructor injection. (3) Entities use jakarta.validation annotations matching frontend validation rules. (4) Proper HTTP status codes (201 Created for POST, 204 No Content for DELETE, 404 for missing resources). (5) Errors should be handled via GlobalExceptionHandler, not try-catch in controllers. (6) JavaDoc on public methods. Suggest improvements if needed.
